name: talaria-v0-4-fleet-turn
description: v0.4 fleet turn: live topology verification and re-pin, multi-profile connection set with per-profile credentials, registry as root object with event routing, focus movement with confirm-before-steal, per-connection seam probes, the needs-you queue and its reserved bar with inline approvals, the fleet replay gate, and the operator-driven live acceptance run.

units.label: Live topology verification and the new pinned read
units.prompt: U1: Turn the plan's Grounding Evidence into the recorded, operator-witnessed protocol baseline at Hermes revision 7095e23eb, and close the live-only questions: empirical scoped routing (a session created on connection A produces nothing on connection B), active_list status transitions for every prompt kind, approval.pending row shape and start stamps, cross-session approval.respond, whether approval.request events carry the synthesized request_id, and the activate steal plus pending_approval/pending_clarify hydration end-to-end. Preflight, halt without it: obtain the operator-supplied disposable test workspace identity and throwaway-session inventory before the first mutating call — no mutation against an unnamed workspace. Use disposable sessions in that workspace only; invoke read-only methods and evidence-only respond calls against throwaway sessions only; never type a real secret; redaction-check any capture before citing it. Write the dated evidence document and update the protocol-surface and reconciliation-rules analyses (record RR-28's request_id drift). Read docs/plans/2026-08-16-talaria-v0-4-fleet-turn-plan.md (unit U1, KTD4, KTD8, KTD12, PC1) as your authoritative spec. Update the Hermes terminal UI feature-inventory analysis with keep/change/drop verdicts for affected rows at the running revision.
units.worth_it_because: operator escalation ruling 2026-08-17: run the v0.4 spine one tier up

units.label: Adversarial review of U1's evidence documents
units.prompt: CR1: Adversarially review U1's diff — the topology evidence document and the two updated analyses. Attempt to refute: any claim without a recorded observation behind it, any capture cited without a redaction check, any drift assertion that does not name both revisions, and any live-leg conclusion the recorded evidence does not actually support. Return only findings that survive your own verification, each with file:line. Read docs/plans/2026-08-16-talaria-v0-4-fleet-turn-plan.md (unit U1) for what the evidence must establish. End with a machine-readable verdict line: VERDICT: clean, or VERDICT: blocked (with the surviving findings above it). A blocked verdict halts every dependent unit until remediation and re-review.
units.worth_it_because: operator escalation ruling 2026-08-17: run the v0.4 spine one tier up

units.label: Connection set: N gateways, per-profile credentials, profile-tagged recording
units.prompt: U2: Build the ConnectionSet owning one LiveSource per configured profile endpoint plus the credential-file default — per-connection epochs, reconnect, correlators, redaction; frames tagged with connection identity; the credential file's backward-compatible [profiles.<name>] token-only entries with refresh-credential --profile (endpoints live solely in config; same-URL profiles share a connection only with byte-identical tokens, else refuse loud); the recorder's multi-connection contract per KTD6 — per-frame profile keys, header connections list, and header version 2 on multi-connection runs; single-connection runs emit none of it and stay version-1 byte-identical, so the TypeScript equivalence corpus is untouched (record the contract in docs/formats/frame-log.md); /profiles ensures a connection instead of drop-switching. Run the project checks (uv sync --all-groups; uv run ruff check .; uv run mypy; uv run pytest; uv run bandit -r talaria -q; git diff --check). Never run ruff format. Read docs/plans/2026-08-16-talaria-v0-4-fleet-turn-plan.md (unit U2, KTD1, KTD5, KTD6, OP1) as your authoritative spec.
units.worth_it_because: operator escalation ruling 2026-08-17: run the v0.4 spine one tier up

units.prompt: CR2: Adversarially review U2's diff. Attempt to refute: epoch or reconnect bookkeeping that drifts when duplicated across sockets, a credential path that borrows or leaks another profile's token, a recorder change that could alter single-connection output bytes, a /profiles path that still drops a socket, and any 0600-discipline hole. Return only findings that survive your own verification, each with file:line. Read docs/plans/2026-08-16-talaria-v0-4-fleet-turn-plan.md (unit U2, KTD1, KTD5, KTD6) for the contract. units.prompt: U3: Invert the domain root — FleetState wraps the existing TalariaState as the focused cursor's engine, with registry rows keyed (profile, durable_id), runtime-id aliases, ownership bookkeeping, KTD10 lifecycle vocabulary plus the three observation classes, seeding from session.list (never-observed) and session.active_list (live), the KTD2 poll loop, session.reclaimed retirement, the dual-listing retirement rule with the 256-row bound, routing that replaces the cross-talk discard (AE1's test must fail against the current discard-and-count behavior), and R25 identity-less events on the connection channel. The domain imports no terminal framework; tests/domain/test_boundary.py stays green. Run the project checks; never run ruff format. Read docs/plans/2026-08-16-talaria-v0-4-fleet-turn-plan.md (unit U3, KTD2, KTD3, KTD10, KTD12, PC2) as your authoritative spec.

Cover KTD12's 'waiting >= observed span' rendering and KTD13's pending_prompts focused-only pin (extend tests/domain/test_projection.py; add the focused-scope qualifier to docs/formats/status-line.md).

units.label: Live acceptance: checklist authored, evidence staged, operator drives
units.prompt: U9: Author the live acceptance checklist from the plan's U9 — every leg with its expected observation, the steal leg (cancel then confirm), the two-profile prerequisite named, and the safety envelope verbatim (throwaway sessions only, canary approvals, no live secrets, redaction-check before citing, a failing leg stops the run, close what you open). Stage the results document skeleton. The drive itself is operator-performed; this unit's completion is the checklist and skeleton existing and the prerequisite's status honestly recorded — it must not claim the drive happened. Read docs/plans/2026-08-16-talaria-v0-4-fleet-turn-plan.md (unit U9, AE10) as your authoritative spec.
